interpretation: Parser recovery is evidence of extraction limits, not proof of invalid Roblox/Luau source.
Lua grammar is used for .luau; Luau-specific syntax can trigger parser recovery.
No-symbol files may be valid data literals, configuration, or scripts without modeled definitions.
Represented node counts use final AST source_file attribution; symbol counts use per-file pre-resolution cache.
Cache matching independently verifies source content plus normalized relative path; no extraction was rerun.
All 921 selected files without final AST nodes are JSON data/snapshots: 913 were intentionally skipped by the native JSON extractor and 8 extraction failures are listed separately.
Thirty-eight JavaScript-family files have no per-file cache; their parser/no-symbol metadata is unavailable here. Cache-derived counts are not claimed to exhaust the extraction log.
Any parser recovery is broader than the native partial-extraction warning: warning only when cached nodes <= 1 or recovery spans multiple lines.
